body:
BLOCKED: PR #61 (branch `feat/issue-21`) implements the full issue — schema/DDL, the generic choke-point (idempotency + ifVersion), SchedulerStore (heartbeats, sweep, onItemEvent, timezone/DST), the rollup engine (config validation, mirror lifecycle checks, deterministic recompute, backfill), eager property-type migration, `packages/queue` (graphile-worker wrapper), the permission-manifest generator + owner_process drift check, the agent_runs delegation model with a `core.agentRun` stub, and the Semprec/System-settings seed. `pnpm build` and `pnpm test` (40 tests, run against a real embedded Postgres) both pass, and I did a self-review pass against `review-rules/` and fixed everything it found.

I cannot get the PR to green, though: the required `review` check fails inside the private `code-review-bot` repo's own script, not in anything this PR touches:

```
/home/runner/work/semprec/semprec/.code-review-bot/scripts/run-review-github.sh: line 119: /usr/bin/jq: Argument list too long
##[error]Process completed with exit code 126
```

This reproduced identically on a retry (pushed an empty commit to retrigger — same line, same error, ~25s both times), so it isn't flaky. My working theory: this is the first PR since the repo went from scaffold-only to a real implementation, and this issue's diff (57 files, ~5k lines — the largest in the queue by design, since it's the foundation everything else stands on) is large enough to overflow whatever `jq` invocation `run-review-github.sh` builds at line 119 (most likely an `--argjson`/positional argument built from the full diff or file list rather than piped via stdin). I don't have access to `dvdtrsnk/code-review-bot` to confirm the exact line or fix it, and per the repo's own security review rules I shouldn't touch `.github/workflows/` to route around a required check even if I could.

A human needs to either fix `run-review-github.sh` (pipe the large payload through stdin/a temp file instead of argv) or otherwise decide how to get this specific PR reviewed. I've left PR #61 open and pushed; issue #21 stays open per the work-issue runbook.

body:
Done. Merged to develop as 561bd71ea5e4e142411d105a7f041bc866a936f7.

Implemented the full data layer foundation: Postgres schema (databases/properties/relation_definitions/items partitioned by database_id/item_relations/project_heartbeats/agent_runs/resource_grants/rollup_dependencies/notifications/users), the generic choke-point CRUD service enforcing locked/schema_locked/owner with Idempotency-Key + ifVersion optimistic concurrency, eager property-type migration (idempotent under graphile-worker retries), the SchedulerStore heartbeat module (5 rule kinds, DST-safe via Luxon, FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED sweep, onItemEvent write-path trigger), the rollup engine (config validation, mirror lifecycle checks, 3 trigger events, backfill that doesn't hold a pool connection across its full walk), packages/queue on graphile-worker, the permission manifest + drift-check heartbeat, owner_process orphan detection, the agent_runs delegation model with core.agentRun as an injectable stub, and the Semp/Semprec system seed (System settings + Projects, both schema-locked).

Notes for dependent issues:
- The choke-point's public store functions (propertiesStore/itemsStore/databasesStore/relationsStore) are intentionally NOT re-exported from the package's index.ts barrel — only their input types are. Go through `createChokePoint()`.
- `computedKeyRegistry.ts` (a Set<string> of declared module cache keys, same temporary-stub pattern as ActionRegistry) already guards property creation against colliding with a future module's computed key; issue #29 populates it.
- CI-layer import ban (dependency-cruiser) and Postgres role separation (semprec_data/semprec_side) are issue #40's scope, not this one — see the PR discussion for the exact quotes from #40's spec justifying that split.
- This PR went through 8 review rounds; a real infra bug was found and fixed along the way (code-review-bot's own file-fetch script crashed on this PR's diff size — see the code-review-bot repo, commit 0a8279e).
